touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Corby Glen qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST JOHN and Corby Glen market cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Corby Glen: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Corby Glen offers CHURCH OF ST JOHN, Corby Glen market cross, MARKET CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST JOHN
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST JOHN and Corby Glen market cross, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
